deals.comment: SK Telecom Co. Ltd. resolved to purchase a 60% interest in YBM Seoul Records on May 27, 2005 for a reported consideration of approximately KRW 29.2 billion ($29.14 million). The number of acquired shares is 4,885,009, or 43.33% of the issued and outstanding shares of YBM Seoul Records, which includes SK Telecom’s option to purchase 4,697,312 new shares of YBM Seoul Records to be issued. SK Telecom intends to exercise such option on the date as agreed upon with YBM Seoul Records. The acquisition price of KRW 12.7 billion ($12.67 million) for the issued and outstanding shares was funded from SK Telecom’s reserved earnings. The conversion was made through www.oanda.com on May 26, 2005.
RealNetworks Inc. (NasdaqGS: RNWK) acquired 11.58% stake in LOEN Entertainment Inc (KOSE: A016170) from SK Telecom Co. Ltd. (KOSE: A017670) for $9.9 million in the fourth quarter of 2008.

Star Invest Holdings Limited signed a contract to acquire 52.56% stake in LOEN Entertainment, Inc. (KOSE:A016170) from SK Planet Co., Ltd. for approximately KRW 270 million on July 18, 2013. Star Invest Holdings Limited will acquire 13.29 million shares at KRW 20,000 per share. The transaction is expected to close by October 16, 2013 and payment will also be made by October 16, 2012.

Star Invest Holdings Limited and two related parties acquired an additional 8.83% stake of LOEN Entertainment, Inc. (KOSE:A016170) from RealNetworks Inc. (NasdaqGS:RNWK) for KRW 31.3 billion on November 8, 2013. As a part of the acquisition, the buyers acquired 2.23 million shares of LOEN, increasing their stake from 67.59% to 76.42% in LOEN.

deals.sellers: Affinity Equity Partners Limited; SK Planet Co., Ltd.; Star Invest Holdings Limited
deals.comment: Kakao Corp. (KOSDAQ:A035720) entered into an agreement to acquire 76.4% stake in LOEN Entertainment, Inc. (KOSDAQ:A016170) from SK Planet Co., Ltd., Star Invest Holdings Limited and Affinity Equity Partners for KRW 1.9 trillion on January 11, 2016. Kakao Corp will acquire 19.3 million shares at an offer per share of KRW 97,000. The acquisition will partly be funded through a private placement of 6.9 million shares of Kakao Corp at KRW 109,121 per share to raise KRW 754.4 billion. SK Planet Co., Ltd. and Affinity Equity Partners along with some other investors will also participate in the placement. The rest will be covered via Kakao's cash holdings, merger and acquisition financing and by inviting outside investments. As on January 11, 2016, Affinity Equity Partners sold its 61.4% stake in Loen and Kakao Corp will now acquire 15% stake from SK Planet Co., Ltd. for KRW 900 billion. SK Planet shall receive KRW 219 billion as consideration. The transaction is expected to close on February 29, 2016. The transaction is now expected to complete on March 10, 2016. The expected closing date for the transaction is changed to March 16, 2016. SK Planet Co., Ltd. used the cash proceeds to invest in the acquisition of 1.4 million shares of Kakao Corp. Yun Sung-jo of Bae, Kim & Lee and Song Chang-hyun of Shin & Kim acted as legal advisors to Kakao in the deal. Credit Suisse acted as financial advisor for Affinity Equity Partners and LOEN Entertainment. Ernst & Young Han Young acted as financial advisor and provided due diligence and accounting advisory services to Kakao.

Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720) agreed to acquire remaining 23.6% in Kakao M Corp. (KOSDAQ:A016170) for approximately KRW 830 billion on May 17, 2018. A merger agreement is expected to be signed on May 18, 2018. As per terms, 0.8023366 shares of Kakao Corp. will be issued as consideration for every one share in Kakao M Corp and thus, 7 million new shares of Kakao Corp. will be issued. The largest shareholder of Kakao Corp., Beom-Soo Kim and his specially related parties collectively hold a 31.94% stake and post-merger, they will remain the largest shareholder in Kakao Corp. and will hold 29.23%. Post completion of merger, Kakao Corp. will be the surviving entity and Kakao M Corp. will cease to exist. The transaction will terminate if any required authorizations or approvals of relevant government authorities is denied, or such events occur.

The deal is subject to approval from Board of Directors of Kakao Corp. due on July 5, 2018. The Board of Directors resolved the deal on May 17, 2018. The shareholders can file dissent for the merger from June 4, 2018 to June 18, 2018 and creditors can object the deal from July 6, 2018 to August 7, 2018. On July 5, 2018, the shareholders of Kakao M Corp. and Board of Kakao Corp. approved the transaction. New shares will be listed on September 18, 2018. As on July 26, 2018, Kakao Corp. resolved not to use the rights of merger contract termination through stock option exercise request. It is expected that the merger will increase shareholder value and have a positive effect on the finances and business of Kakao Corp.
Deok Kyun Jeong, Hyeyeon Han, Yang Geun-hwan and Jaeduk Han acquired 1.44% stake in Kakao M Corp. for KRW 13.6 billion on September 28, 2019.
